_comment: Configuration for tools/l10n-guard.sh. Data-driven so expanding scope is a
config change, not a code change.
'auditedPaths' are files/directories that have BEEN migrated to
LocalizedStringResource. Only they are subject to the strict
copy-typed-as-string rule; everything else in the repo is grandfathered so
the guard reports real regressions instead of drowning in ~1,140 known-legacy
strings. Add a path here as part of migrating that slice — that is what makes
The other rules are safe enough to run repo-wide because they are
syntactically decidable and cannot be confused by content-vs-copy ambiguity.
_neverTranslateComment: Brand, product and format names. A translator seeing 'Plex' in a catalog has
no way to know it must not be translated, and some WILL translate it. These
must reach the UI as Text(verbatim:) so they are never extracted at all.
